newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish 20-yr bond auction covered 4.21 times - NTMA.
newsitem.headline: Irish 20-yr bond auction covered 4.21 times - NTMA.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) said on Tuesday its competitive auction of 75 million punts of the 8.25 percent bond due 2015 had been covered 4.21 times.
The NTMA said the highest accepted price was 105.17 for an annual yield of 7.72 percent while the lowest accepted price was 105.07 for an annual yield of 7.73 percent.
It said 75 percent of each bid at the lowest price was filled.
The average price was 105.10 for an annual yield of 7.73 percent.
The NTMA said that its non-competitive auction for primary dealers of up to 22.5 million punts of the 20-year bond was at a price of 105.10.
